_comment: The daily orchestration: RDS -> raw -> silver -> gold, in Glue alone.
No EventBridge rule and no Step Function -- a SCHEDULED trigger starts the
chain and two CONDITIONAL triggers carry it forward.
WHY A SUBDIRECTORY. infra/glue/*.json is one file per Glue JOB, and both
the validate step and the deploy step derive the job name from the
filename. A workflow file sitting beside them would be deployed as
`aws glue update-job --job-name gp_daily` and fail. Keeping workflows one
level down keeps that glob meaning exactly one thing.
WHY THE SCHEDULE IS NOT ARMED. StartOnCreation is false on the clock
trigger and true on the two that follow it. The conditional triggers do
nothing until something upstream succeeds, so arming them is free; the
clock trigger bills three Glue jobs a day forever, so switching it on is a
deliberate act and not a side effect of a push:
aws glue start-trigger --name gp_daily_start
aws glue stop-trigger  --name gp_daily_start
StartOnCreation only applies at creation. Flipping it to true in this file
will NOT arm a trigger that already exists -- use start-trigger.
WHY 07:00 UTC. The extract window is [period, period + 1 day) on
inserted_at, and the period defaults to yesterday UTC, so the day being
processed has to have closed. Seven hours of margin means a row stamped
at 23:59 and committed slightly late is still inside the window. Glue cron
is always UTC, takes six fields, and requires `?` in either day-of-month
or day-of-week.
WHY SUCCEEDED AND NOT ANY TERMINAL STATE. A failed ingest must stop the
chain: running raw_to_silver on a partial day would merge an incomplete
batch into silver, and gold would then aggregate it. Glue by itself does
not notify -- the workflow run in the console is the record. Anything that
emails you needs an EventBridge rule, which is outside `Glue alone`.

Workflow.Name: gp_daily
Workflow.Description: Daily: RDS -> raw -> silver -> gold. Scheduled trigger plus two conditional triggers.

Triggers.Name: gp_daily_start
Triggers.Description: 07:00 UTC daily. Starts the chain at the raw ingest.

Triggers.Name: gp_daily_to_silver
Triggers.Description: raw -> silver, only once the ingest has succeeded.

Triggers.Name: gp_daily_to_gold
Triggers.Description: silver -> gold, only once raw_to_silver has succeeded.
